title: Pew ATP Wave 173 - AI and its impact
methodology_notes: Wave 173 of Pew Research Center's American Trends Panel (ATP), a probability-based online panel recruited via address-based sampling. The June 2025 wave was fielded primarily online, with some interviews conducted by live telephone; programming shown in this encoding follows the online administration. Weights are raked to demographic benchmarks. Every published percentage in this file is reported under base.kind="all", so 'Not sure' and 'No answer' appear in the denominator. Following Pew convention, published "<1" percentages are rendered here as 1. The "No answer" code captures web respondents who did not answer, phone respondents who refused, and phone respondents who said they did not know how to answer - except where "Not sure" was offered as an explicit option, in which case "No answer" is limited to web skips and phone refusals. Prior-wave entries (2021-2024) are carried as trend-reference stubs so trend rows from the topline can be read as a single series; authoritative methodology for those waves lives with the original Pew releases.
